verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਹ ਤਾਲ ਅਊਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਲ ਪੁਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: tereh taal uooriaa gurmukh sukh tap taal puraiaa|

en.bdb: Thirteen beats of music are incomplete but the gurmukh with his accomplishment of the rythm (of household life) attains delight.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਹ ਰਤਨ ਅਕਾਰਥੇ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: tereh ratan akaarathe gur upadhes ratan dhan paiaa|

en.bdb: Thirteen jewels are also  futile for the Gurmukh who gets the jewel of teaching of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਹ ਪਦ ਕਰਿ ਜਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਿਤਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: tereh padh kar jag vich pitar karam kar bharam bhulaiaa|

en.bdb: The ritualistic people have overawed the people in their thirteen types of rituals.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਜਗ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਪੀਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lakh jag na pujanee gursikh charanodhak peeaaiaa|

en.bdb: Myriad burnt offerings (yajna) cannot be equated with nectar of the feet of the gurmukh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਨਈਵੇਦ ਲਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਣਾ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: jag bhog nieevedh lakh gurmukh mukh ik dhaanaa paiaa|

en.bdb: Even one grain of a gurmukh is equal to millions of yajnas, offerings and edibles.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਭਾਈ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਚਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurbhaiee sa(n)tusaT kar gurmukh sukh fal piram chakhaiaa|

en.bdb: And by making their fellow disciples of the Guru content, the Gurmukhs remain happy.
God is undeceivable but He is dodged by the devotees.
